parameters.content:
## Product Image Sync — Production
Started from the Product Image Sync web app through an authenticated webhook.

Web app → n8n → Product Image Sync API → server-side worker → Google Drive → Shopify.

The webhook returns the job ID immediately after the worker starts. n8n then continues polling the same job. Google and Shopify tokens never leave the Product Image Sync server.

**LOCAL SETUP:** n8n runs at http://localhost:5678 and calls the Product Image Sync API at http://localhost:3000/api/n8n/v1.

assignments.name: baseUrlNote
assignments.value: LOCAL DEVELOPMENT — n8n calls the Product Image Sync app on this computer.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Product Image Sync API authentication failed (check the "Product Image Sync API" credential and its scopes)' + ' at ' + $json.step + ': HTTP ' + $json.http_status + ' ' + $json.code + ' — ' + $json.message + ' [request_id ' + $json.request_id + ']' }}

={{ 'Store not found or not accessible with this API key' + ' at ' + $json.step + ': HTTP ' + $json.http_status + ' ' + $json.code + ' — ' + $json.message + ' [request_id ' + $json.request_id + ']' }}

={{ 'Sync job not created' + ' at ' + $json.step + ': HTTP ' + $json.http_status + ' ' + $json.code + ' — ' + $json.message + ' [request_id ' + $json.request_id + ']' + ($json.active_job_id ? ' (active job ' + $json.active_job_id + ')' : '') }}
={{ 'The sync worker could not be started' + ' at ' + $json.step + ': HTTP ' + $json.http_status + ' ' + $json.code + ' — ' + $json.message + ' [request_id ' + $json.request_id + ']' }}
={{ 'Product Image Sync API error' + ' at ' + $json.step + ': HTTP ' + $json.http_status + ' ' + $json.code + ' — ' + $json.message + ' [request_id ' + $json.request_id + ']' }}

={{ 'Store ' + $json.store_id + ' is not ready for sync: shopify_connected=' + $json.shopify_connected + ' (' + $json.shopify_status + '), google_drive_connected=' + $json.google_drive_connected + ', root_folder_selected=' + $json.root_folder_selected }}

={{ 'Sync job ' + $('Check Create Sync Job').first().json.job_id + ' did not finish within ' + $('Config').first().json.maxPolls + ' polls / ' + $('Config').first().json.maxPollMinutes + ' minutes. The job keeps running on the server — check it later with GET /sync-jobs/{jobId}. It was NOT cancelled.' }}

={{ 'Sync job was cancelled' + ' (job ' + $json.job_id + ', store ' + $json.store_id + '): processed ' + $json.progress.processed + '/' + $json.progress.total + ', uploaded ' + $json.progress.uploaded + ', skipped ' + $json.progress.skipped + ', review ' + $json.progress.review + ', failed ' + $json.progress.failed + '. Completed uploads were kept.' }}

={{ 'Sync job failed' + ' (job ' + $json.job_id + ', store ' + $json.store_id + '): processed ' + $json.progress.processed + '/' + $json.progress.total + ', uploaded ' + $json.progress.uploaded + ', skipped ' + $json.progress.skipped + ', review ' + $json.progress.review + ', failed ' + $json.progress.failed + ($json.error ? ' — ' + $json.error.code + ': ' + $json.error.message : '') + '. Completed uploads were kept.' }}
